description: A reliable multi-role SDLC workflow for Codex with review gates, human checkpoints, atomic state, and meeting records.

interface.shortDescription: Risk-adaptive product, engineering, and testing workflow.
interface.longDescription: Run a formal software delivery workflow in any project without copying project files. The orchestrator performs evidence-backed requirement and risk triage, selects the lowest safe micro, quick, standard, or strict flow, locks user-confirmed core outcomes, prevents silent scope reduction, binds strict verification to a committed source revision, requires semantic final-user-journey checks, coordinates independent product, engineering, and testing work, and preserves checksummed state, human authorization checkpoints, and structured meeting records.
